description: Create a comprehensive guide on building a web automation agent architecture. The guide should cover a comparison of Selenium, Playwright, and Puppeteer; methods for LLM integration in web agents; autonomous navigation strategies; error handling and CAPTCHA solving; and the design of agentic workflows for web browsing.
expected_output: A comprehensive Markdown article structured as a technical guide, stored in the system repository.
search_prompt: comprehensive guide to web automation agent architecture Selenium vs Playwright vs Puppeteer LLM integration for web agents autonomous web navigation error handling CAPTCHA solving agentic workflows for web browsing
title: Building a Web Automation Agent Architecture: A Comprehensive Guide
